proc_p: Sliding wardrobes take four to six weeks to make once the design is signed off.
steps: We measure the opening and check the floor and ceiling are level enough for the track.
You choose mirror, glass, wood-effect or painted doors and see them in 3D, with an itemised quote.
The doors and the interior are made to your opening in our workshop.
We fit the tracks and adjust the doors so they glide, backed by our 12-month guarantee.
book_p: Send a photo of the wall on WhatsApp or book a visit. We’ll measure the opening and send a 3D design with an itemised quote.
